Question 20

The intensity I of a light source with a motion sensor increases at a rate that's inversely proportional to the square of the distance d from the source to the object detected by the sensor. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the intensity of the light source I?

a
dIdt=−kI2,k>0
b
dIdt=kI2,k>0
c
dIdt=kd2,k>0
d
dIdt=kd2,k>0
e
dIdt=−kd2,k>0
